links.comparator_used: Control group with standard care and no specific hemodynamic protocol
links.outcome: Frequency, duration and severity of intraoperative hypotension (MAP <65 mmHg) during lung surgery with single lung ventilation
links.effect: Hypotensive episodes 0 [0-1] vs 1 [0-2], p=0.01; duration 0 min [0-3.17] vs 2.33 min [0-7.42], p=0.01; area under MAP 65 0 [0-12] vs 10.67 [0-44.16] mmHg*min, p<0.01; TWA of MAP 65 0 [0-0.08] vs 0.07 [0-0.25] mmHg, p<0.01. No significant difference in postoperative AKI (6.7% vs 4.2%, p=0.72); MINS trend 17.1% vs 31.8% (p=0.07); infection trend 16.0% vs 26.8% (p=0.16).
links.quote: The number of hypotensive episodes was lower in the intervention group compared to the control group (0 [0-1] vs. 1 [0-2]; p = 0.01), the duration of hypotension was shorter in the intervention group (0 min [0-3.17] vs. 2.33 min [0-7.42]; p = 0.01).
